# Retsinformation fixtures (Denmark)

Lex Dania XML of seven lovbekendtgørelser, exactly as served by Retsinformation (Civilstyrelsen),
gzip-compressed. The first four retrieved 2026-10-14, the others 2026-10-15, from `https://www.retsinformation.dk/eli/lta/<year>/<number>/xml`.

| File | Document |
|---|---|
| `lbk-2007-1365.xml.gz` | Forvaltningsloven, LBK nr 1365 af 07/12/2007 (historic) |
| `lbk-2012-988.xml.gz` | Forvaltningsloven, LBK nr 988 af 09/10/2012 (historic) |
| `lbk-2014-433.xml.gz` | Forvaltningsloven, LBK nr 433 af 22/04/2014 (current; two later amending acts) |
| `lbk-2016-193.xml.gz` | Aftaleloven, LBK nr 193 af 02/03/2016 (current; §§ 37-38 repealed) |
| `lbk-2026-807.xml.gz` | Lov om fleksydelse, LBK nr 807 af 22/09/2026 (no PopularTitle in the metadata) |
| `lbk-2026-849.xml.gz` | Aktieavancebeskatningsloven, LBK nr 849 (paragraphs "§ 4 A" with an upper-case letter) |
| `lbk-2026-870.xml.gz` | Folkeskoleloven, LBK nr 870 af 29/09/2026 (has a `<Praeambel>`) |
